title: On automorphisms of $p$-torsion $\mathbf{G}_m$-gerbes
summary: Rouquier proved that for a smooth projective variety $X$, the group scheme $\operatorname{Pic}^0_X \rtimes \operatorname{Aut}^0_X$ is an invariant of the derived category of $X$. This was generalized to the twisted case by Olsson, who associated a group algebraic space $\operatorname{Aut}^0_{\mathcal{X}}$ to a $\mathbf{G}_m$-gerbe $\mathcal{X} \to X$ and proved it to be a twisted derived invariant.
